output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not contain any checks for integer overflow. If the value being transferred exceeds the maximum value that can be stored in the uint256 data type, it will cause an integer overflow, leading to loss of funds or other unexpected behavior.

The mintToken function does not contain any checks for integer overflow. If the amount being minted exceeds the maximum value that can be stored in the uint256 data type, it will cause an integer overflow, leading to loss of funds or other unexpected behavior.
